d: Veronica helps her new boyfriend find his father's stolen car, but the situation turns dangerous. Plus, Veronica uncovers a secret while investigating her mother's whereabouts.

Veronica investigates the disappearance of her pregnant upstairs neighbor. Plus, Veronica learns information about her mother and Duncan's father.

Mars Investigations looks into a cultish group joined by a Neptune High senior. Meanwhile, Veronica attempts to dispel a claim made by a condemned killer.
Veronica investigates missing poker winnings, and Keith is hired by Lynn Echolls to track down one of the potential stalkers of her husband, Aaron.

George's parents are thrown upon meeting his new girlfriend, Tansy (Mircea Monroe). George's mother devises a plan forcing George and Zoe to address their feelings for one another.
When a flu epidemic heads toward BlueBell, Zoe puts the town on lockdown -- but gets jealous when Wade must stay at his ex-girlfriend's house. Lemon's plans go awry.

st: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
d: Zoe tries to keep her feelings about Wade under control. Lavon and Wade are forced to work together at the church's casino fundraiser, but when money is missing, Wade is suspected.
